name: C20 a mapping on a signal catch event is never applied (engine behaviour pinned)
description: A signal catch event with an output mapping that would rename carrier to renamed. Activiti applies no mapping to signal catch events: the payload variable arrives under its own name and the renamed one is never set. The modeler therefore gives signal catch events no default mapping, and the lint rule signal-catch-has-mapping warns about an entry.

scenarios.name: the payload arrives as it was thrown and the renaming mapping is not applied
